author: Patrick Ziller
description: Generates a pre-built, security-conscious authentication system into a Rails app: DB-backed sessions with idle/absolute timeouts, paranoid flows, magic links, TOTP MFA, an admin area, and more, all opt-in via flags. Inspired by authentication-zero.

author: Ryan Gavin
description: A terminal monitor for AI coding agents (Claude, Codex) on macOS: per-session CPU, real memory (footprint), disk and network I/O, memory pressure, and a history of runs. macOS only.
